source_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

source_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

source_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
reference: El canyoning el combina elementi del nuoto, rampegada e salto - ma el richiede un alenamento bastansa ridoto o na forma fisica basica pa scomisiar (comparà co la rampegada su croda, escursionismo subacqueo o sci alpino, par esempio).
hypothesis: El canyoning el conbina elementi del nuoto, la scala e el salto - ma el richiede relativamente poca allenamento o forma fisica par scominsiar (par esèmpio, par paragon a l'alpinismo, el scuba diving o el sci alpino).

source_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.
reference: A mappa internasionale sui terremoti del Osservatorio Geologico Statunitense ("United States Geological Survey") no ga mostrà terremoti in Islanda a setimàna prima.
hypothesis: La mapa internasionale dei terremoti del Servizio Geolotego dei Stati Unii la ga mostrà che in Islanda la setimana prima no ghe jera terremoti.

source_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
reference: I tornado sradica alberi, cava assi dae case e buta in aria le machine. El do persento dei tornado pì violenti dura pì de tre ore.
hypothesis: Tornadi che sradicano alberi, strapazzano le tavole dei edifici e butano in alto le auto. I do per cento dei tornadi più violenti i dura più de tre ore.

source_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

source_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

source_text: No major injuries were reported, but at least five people on scene at the time of the explosion were treated for symptoms of shock.

source_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

source_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

source_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

source_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

hypothesis: I sottomarini i xe navi progettadi par viajar soto l'aqua, e i resta lì par un periodo esteso de tempo.

source_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

source_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

hypothesis: El Servizio dei Parchi (MINAE) no el rilascia permessi parchi più de un mese prima de l'arrivo previsto.

source_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

source_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
